newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Dec 15.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Dec 15.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Disputes between newly-recruited Gulf Arab captains on fishing boats in the UAE and other senior Asian ones, who now have to work as fishermen following a federal law to nationalise the industry, is harming business.
- Sole agency rights long enjoyed by a handful of companies on the import of branded goods in Bahrain may be scrapped if the current move to amend the commercial agency law is implemented.

- The airfare hike due to take effect from Sunday may not be implemented across the board, as travel agents say they will collect the surcharge only on behalf of airlines that notify them to that effect.
- Business performance in Dubai shows 4.3 point drop in the third quarter of 1996 against a pojected 29.6 point uptrend, indicators compiled by the Economic Department showed.
